kind: read-only review plus label-free comparison of existing submitted predictions
prior_exposure: The user catalogue, existing 2021/2022/public scores, and archived audits were read before this protocol. The catalogue already reports correlation 0.999967 for submissions 3 and 5; its referenced review JSON is unavailable here.
hypothesis: The highest eligible public-scoring model should occupy one slot; a second slot is useful only if credible performance, different predictions/mechanisms, and feasible offline reproduction justify it.
allowed_arrays: Existing supplied-data-only prediction CSVs for catalogue 3, 5, 2, 17, 19, 25 and 32, with recorded hashes verified before diagnostics. No external-output or retrospective candidates are read.
missing_candidate: Catalogue 4 CSV and cited final_selection_review_20261108.json are absent locally. Do not reconstruct it using a different Round10 recipe or substitute another submission.
data: prediction_mapping.csv dates and sample_submission.csv schema only; no commitment labels
comparisons: Catalogue 3 against each other available candidate; pooled outputs and per-generator differences
diagnostics: fraction differing by more than 0.01 and 0.05
same diagnostics on reference probabilities between 0.1 and 0.9
controls: 3-versus-5 near-sibling; 17 shared anchor; 32 structurally older ensemble
selection_rule: No automated winner or tuning. Recommend two existing eligible submissions by jointly reviewing recorded evidence, prediction/mechanism diversity and raw-data notebook feasibility. Distinguish preferred statistical pair from ready-to-deliver fallback.
acceptance_criterion: Diagnostics are accepted only after exact CSV hashes, schema, case IDs and finite [0,1] checks. They are descriptive and cannot establish private accuracy or error complementarity.
bootstrap_reason: No label-based performance statistic or experiment verdict is computed.
known_limitations: 2021 and 2022 scores are repeatedly reused development evidence
Prediction correlation is not error correlation
Private scores and the user's approximate virtual-team threshold are not verified
